notes.note: RegionPaneHost.project.test.tsx changed only its stale-binding case: the binding naming a deleted project is now set after navigating to /projects/alpha, because #3144 made opening a workspace set the default project for new chats (which would overwrite a binding set before). The case still pins what placement.md describes: the dock host reads around a binding that names a missing project, falling back to the route's project without writing the binding. No placement rule changed.
